steps.title: Project Setup and Configuration
steps.description: Configure the project's build.gradle and target sdk configuration to ensure compatibility with Gradle 8.5 and Temurin 17.

steps.title: Formulating App Manifest
steps.description: Setup the AndroidManifest.xml declaring the launcher Activity, standard dark theme, and portrait orientation constraint.

steps.title: Establish Visual Style Resources
steps.description: Define high-contrast neon visual palette colors, modern dark canvas themes, and button dimension metrics in strings and colors resources.

steps.title: Create Card Background Graphic Assets
steps.description: Design custom rounded corners drawables to act as layout cards for shape selectors and toggle configurations.

steps.title: Model 3D Math Entities
steps.description: Build lightweight, high-performance mathematical classes for managing 3D Vector coordinates, Face polygon indicators, and Model meshes.

steps.title: Formulate 3D Geometric Primitives
steps.description: Code hard-coded vertex and face matrices for rendering dynamic models of Cubes, Pyramids, Octahedrons, Triangular Prisms, and 24-faced Stars.

steps.title: Implement Depth-Buffered Face Sorter
steps.description: Program the Painter's Algorithm sorting system to analyze average Z heights, rendering rear-facing faces first to prevent visual overlap artifacts.

steps.title: Incorporate Dot Product Face Shading
steps.description: Formulate 3D vector mathematics utilizing normalized cross-products to render ambient and diffuse dynamic lighting on shape faces.

steps.title: Embed Touch Inertia Rotations
steps.description: Implement drag movement gesture logic and pinch-to-zoom multi-touch handling for spinning and resizing meshes interactively.

steps.title: Build Neon Control Console UI
steps.description: Assemble XML containing real-time rotation speed SeekBars, Light direction coordinates, toggles, and horizontal selector buttons.

steps.title: Wire Main Activity Core Controller
steps.description: Program binding code in MainActivity.java to link SeekBars, switches, and geometry selection buttons directly with state controls.

steps.title: Building 3D Shape Studio
steps.description: Compile assets and execute tests on the custom rendering frame pipeline, confirming zero memory leaks and 60 FPS runtime performance.
